value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Sc with mathematics (statistics too, for some statistics programmes). Routes: IIT JAM for IITs, IISc and NITs; CUET-PG (NTA) for central and other universities; ISI's own test for M.Stat and M.Math; and state or university tests elsewhere.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common next steps: a PhD (via CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or institute tests), college teaching (UGC-NET), or school teaching with a B.Ed.
Statistics and applied-maths graduates also move into data, analytics and actuarial roles, usually after learning programming.
UPSC's Indian Statistical Service exam is open to those with statistics at bachelor's level or a master's in statistics.
